axes.concept: Keep the current Taller as the working surface: choose a saved decoration below the canvas, inspect it beside the canvas, then place a copy into the current scene.
axes.layout: Existing Pictures masthead, heading and Taller 3D / Proyectos route rule; changed workshop area has a 56px tool rail, flexible canvas above a library tray, and a 280px detail inspector. Below 768px the inspector follows the tray; below 640px the rail disappears.
axes.navigation: Local Mi biblioteca / En este navegador pressed-button navigation changes the tray scope without leaving the Taller; staff also have a labelled Propietario native selector. Selecting a thumbnail changes the inspector; on phone selection focuses and reveals that inspector.
axes.typography: Inherited embedded Geist Sans body 15px, H1 24px/600, inspector and library headings 18px/600, tile names 14px/600, metadata 12–13px. Geist Mono remains in Sempertex masthead metadata.
axes.density: Three compact thumbnail peers per tray row at desktop; two at 768–1099px and on phones, with generous 24px desktop / 20px phone panel insets. One inspector carries the detailed actions instead of repeating them on every thumbnail.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Skeleton, Animate UI-backed Dialog and AlertDialog; native scope buttons, native selects and the inherited account disclosure. Inline SVG illustrates scene/piece thumbnails, never a fake renderer.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures globals.css light/dark tokens mapped to kit roles, including fondo, superficie, texto, acento and Taller canvas/panel roles. Primary colour identifies placing/saving; control edges use the inherited texto-tenue accessible alias.
axes.motion: Finite spatial entrance: library tray rises 24px, inspector enters from 32px right, selected preview seats with scale/rotation, placement springs into the canvas. Expressive 520ms elastic settling and 170ms control gestures; natural/subtle scale down. OS reduced motion, Quieto and still=1 settle immediately; CSS effects pause in hidden tabs.
